name: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems Co., Ltd.
summary: Leader Harmonious Drive Systems Co., Ltd. is involved in the research, development, manufacture, and sales of strain wave reducers in China and internationally. It provides strain wave gears, rotary actuators, frameless direct drive torque motors, and rotary tables for aerospace robotics; automated packaging equipment; industrial robot automation components; industrial laser cutting technology; robotic medical equipment; measurement, analysis, and test equipment; media and communication equipment; mobile humanoid robots; optical equipment; optical reflector telescopes; photovoltaic equipment; precision steering gear; printed circuit board manufacturing equipment; semiconductor manufacturing …
